breadcrumb.name: International Driving License Dubai: Complete Guide 2026

contentHtml:
Travel plans can get so exciting. That is, until you realize your UAE license might not be enough to legally drive abroad. But if you have an international driving license Dubai, you can still go exploring foreign cities on your own terms.

Driving abroad sounds thrilling, but it quickly turns stressful if your license isn’t recognized. That’s exactly why Dubai residents turn to the international driving license. It saves you from any last-minute hiccups at rental counters and checkpoints. In this complete 2026 guide, we will discuss the process, cost, and application steps so you’re always travel-ready.

What is an International Driving License in Dubai?

An international driving license Dubai is an officially recognized document that lets you drive legally outside the UAE. It acts as a bridge between your Dubai-issued driving license and foreign traffic authorities who may not read Arabic or English.

Difference between an International Driving License vs International Driving Permit

The terms are often used interchangeably, but here’s what they mean:

  • International Driving License is the UAE-issued version recognized by global bodies.
  • International Driving Permit (IDP) is the international format that translates your license into multiple languages.

When you apply through the RTA Dubai, you’re essentially getting both in one go.

Why do you need it while driving abroad?

Renting a car overseas is near impossible if you do not have your International Driving License Dubai(IDL). Even if your UAE license is valid, many rental agencies still require it. In case of a car accident, the traffic police abroad will only recognize your IDL and not your UAE card.

Your international license works as a safety net for all the what-if factors you might encounter on foreign roads. Many countries won’t let you rent a car without it, even if you already hold a UAE license.

More importantly, traffic police abroad rely on the IDL to verify your driving eligibility in their language. It protects you from fines, keeps your travel smooth, and prevents unnecessary delays.

Countries where a Dubai-issued international driving license is valid

Over 150 countries recognize a Dubai-issued international driving license, including most of Europe, North America, Asia, and Australia. This makes it a highly practical document for frequent flyers and road trip lovers.

How to Get an International Driving License in Dubai

Getting your international driving license Dubai is simple. All you need to do is know where you should apply and which documents you need to bring along with you. The Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) handles most of these applications, but you can also apply through authorized centers.

Documents required for a Dubai international driving license

Prepare these essentials before applying:

  • Valid UAE driving license
  • Valid Emirates ID
  • Passport copy with residency visa page
  • Passport-size photographs

Keep both hard and soft copies ready if you are applying online.

Step-by-step process (Online & Offline RTA application)

This is how the process usually goes:

Offline at RTA or service centers:

  1. Visit an RTA branch or authorized service center.
  2. Submit the application form with documents.
  3. Pay the applicable fee.
  4. Collect your license on the same day in most cases.

Online via RTA website/app:

  1. Log in with your Emirates ID details.
  2. Upload scanned copies of documents.
  3. Pay the application fee online.
  4. Receive your license by courier.

Eligibility criteria (Residents, Tourists, Expats)

  • Residents: Must hold a valid UAE driving license.
  • Tourists: Cannot apply unless they hold UAE residency. They should get an IDP from their home country before arrival.
  • Expats: As long as they’re residents with a valid UAE license, they’re eligible.

International Driving License Dubai Cost

The cost depends on where and how you apply. While the total amount looks different for everyone, here’s what you can expect with the cost:

Application fee at RTA Dubai

The RTA charges a standard fee for processing your application. The amount varies depending on the service center or if you apply online.

Additional charges (attestation, service fees)

Extra costs may include:

  • Attestation fees for documents
  • Courier charges for home delivery
  • Service fees if you apply through authorized institutes

Costs depend on where you apply, but here’s the standard breakdown:

  • RTA Application Fee: Around AED 170
  • Knowledge/Service Fee: AED 20–30
  • Courier Charges (online applications): AED 20

Estimated Total Cost: AED 200–220

Renewal costs & validity period

A Dubai-issued International Driving License is valid for 1 year from the date of issuance. After it expires, simply repeat the same process to renew it.

  • If your UAE license expires, your IDL becomes automatically invalid. You have to go through the process of UAE Driving License Renewal.
  • If you change your passport or residency status, you must reapply for a new IDL with updated information.

Where to Apply for an International Driving License Dubai

You’re not limited to one channel. Dubai makes it convenient with multiple options.

  • RTA offices & official service centers: Walk into any RTA branch or its partner service centers. It’s the fastest option if you need the license immediately.
  • Online application through RTA website/app: For convenience, apply via the RTA portal or official mobile app. It’s ideal if you don’t want to visit an office in person.
  • Authorized driving institutes in Dubai: Well-known driving institutes like Emirates Driving Institute, Galadari, and Dubai Driving Center are also authorized to issue the license.

Final Word

Your international driving license Dubai application is far more than a mere, simple formality. It is also your ticket to freedom behind the wheel wherever you go. Whether it’s for a weekend getaway or a cross-continent road trip, having this document saves time, stress, and awkward conversations at rental counters.

FAQs for an International Driving License Dubai

Can tourists apply for an international driving license in Dubai?

No. Only UAE residents with a valid driving license can apply. Tourists should get an IDP from their home country before coming to Dubai.

How long does it take to get the license?

If you apply in person at RTA or service centers, you can often receive it the same day. Online applications may take a few working days due to courier delivery.

Is the Dubai international driving license valid in the USA, UK, or Europe?

Yes. The license is recognized in the USA, UK, and across most European countries. Always double-check with the car rental company or local traffic authority before traveling.

Do I need a UAE driving license before applying for an international license?

Yes. The international license is only valid if linked to a UAE-issued driving license. Without one, your application cannot be processed.
